newsitem.title: INDONESIA: IMF chief expects support from President Clinton.
newsitem.headline: IMF chief expects support from President Clinton.

text.p: The director-general of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Thursday he expected continued support from U.S. President Bill Clinton, who was re-elected this week.
"President Clinton has been a great supporter of the IMF, and will certainly continue to be," the IMF's Michel Camdessus told Reuters during an economic meeting in Jakarta.
"The president of the United States has supported the IMF because it is in the interest of the United States, as it is in the interest of the whole world...," he said.
The IMF is based in Washington.
